page.layout: One text column on the right, with the page number at top left and the running head across the top. The left side has no text and no margin notes. Below the column is the catchword.

main_text.p: „ vobis relinquimus Templa, cui bello non „ idonei, non prompti fuiffemus ? etiam „ impares copy s (qui tam libenter trucida- „ mur )fi non apud iftam difciplinam occidi „ magis liceret,quàm occidere ; Potuimus „ & inermes, nec rebelles : fed tan- „ tummodo difcordes folius diuortij „ inuidia, aduerfus vos dimicaffe. Si e- „ nim tanta vis hominum in aliquem „ orbis remoti finum abrupiflemus à „ vobis, fufiudiffet vtique dominatio- „ nem veftram tot qualiumcunque a- „ milfiho ciuium ; imo etiam & ipfi de- „ ftitutione puniiffet ; Proculdubio ex- „ pauiffetis ad solitudinem veftram, ad „ silentium rerum, & ftuporem quen- „ dam,quæ suffetis [?] in ea quibus imperaf- „ fetis, plures hoftes quàm ciues vobis „ remanfiffent. Nunc enim pauciores „ hoftes habetis præ multitudine Chri- „ ftianorum, penè omnium Ciuium ; „ penè omnes ciues Chriftianos ha- „ bendo.] Peto a lectore non nimis fe- ftinante, vt hæc Tertulliani verba, licet alicubi Affricanam fpirantia afperita- tem, apud ipfum Autorem relegere dignetur unà cum Paraphrafi Francifci

page.notes: Lines begin with printed quotation marks („) at each line; these are kept as printed. Line 3, "copy s": doubtful, possibly "copys" with a damaged letter. Line 4, "mur )fi": the bracket is printed, reading uncertain. Line 4, "iftam": doubtful reading. Line 12, "qualiumcunque": the second letter is unclear. Line 17, "suffetis [?]": the word before "fetis" is damaged and uncertain. The running head reads "Scutum Regium" with "LIB. II." printed beside it; both are kept. Text at the far right edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is left out.
